question: For each customer segment (SME, LAM, KAM), compute the percentage change in total consumption between 2012 and 2013 among those who pay in EUR, and return only the segment with the highest positive percentage increase.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_002" AS segment
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY T1."XCL_002"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END)) > 0
ORDER BY CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) -
               SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 /
         SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1
